component-wallet-clustering-intro: Many people give each purpose its own wallet: one for savings, one for trading, one for trying new apps. On a public ledger they can still add up to one person. Analysts join addresses using heuristics, rules of thumb that tie two addresses to the same owner. Apply four common ones, one at a time, to seven addresses that look unrelated.
component-wallet-clustering-demo-title: Clustering, one heuristic at a time

component-wallet-clustering-step-1-evide: The Savings address sent the very first ETH that the Trading, Staking and Memecoins addresses ever received.
component-wallet-clustering-step-1-expla: A new address can't do anything until someone pays for its gas. The first payment into it shows who that was.
component-wallet-clustering-step-2-evide: Airdrop 1 and Airdrop 2 claimed the same airdrop minutes apart. Then Airdrop 2 sent its tokens to Airdrop 1.
component-wallet-clustering-step-2-expla: Airdrop teams run this same check to catch people claiming with many wallets.
component-wallet-clustering-step-3-evide: The Trading address and Airdrop 1 both sent funds to the same exchange deposit address.
component-wallet-clustering-step-3-expla: Exchanges give each customer a personal deposit address. Two wallets paying into the same one usually belong to the same customer.
component-wallet-clustering-step-4-evide: The Savings address put {amount} into a <glossary>shielded pool</glossary>, a shared pool that hides which deposit pays for which withdrawal. Ten minutes later, the Private address took exactly the same amount out.
component-wallet-clustering-step-4-expla: The pool's cryptography held. The habits around it didn't.
component-wallet-clustering-step-5-evide: The Savings address has a public <glossary>ENS</glossary> name, {ensName}. Its profile links a social account with a job title and a home city.
component-wallet-clustering-step-5-expla: One name on one address now names all seven.
component-wallet-clustering-verdict: Each heuristic on its own links only a few addresses. Together they turned seven addresses that looked unrelated into one cluster, and one public name labeled all of it.
component-wallet-clustering-caption: The addresses and links are a sample. Each heuristic shown here is one that analysts use.
